ev.q: During 2022, 8,300 TB cases were reported in the United States, compared with 7,874 during 2021.
TB incidence during 2022 increased slightly to 2.5 per 100,000 persons, compared with 2.4 during 2021.
Among 84.7% of persons with TB that had a known HIV status, 4.7% were coinfected in 2022 compared with 4.3% in 2021.
TB incidence during 2022 increased slightly to 2.5 per 100,000 persons
Compared with that in 2021, incidence in 2022 increased 63% among Asian persons
Health departments in the 50 U.S. states and DC electronically report verified TB cases to CDC
During 2022, TB incidence increased slightly to 2.5 although it remained lower than during prepandemic years

methods_quotes.q: TB incidence was calculated using midyear population estimates and stratified by birth origin and by race and ethnicity.
Midyear population estimates from the Current Population Survey are used to calculate incidence by U.S. birth origin
Percentage change is calculated from unrounded numbers.
Percentages are calculated only among patients with available data
Proportions using birth origin are calculated excluding those with missing data.
